page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ine.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by dedicated Intel Xeon processors running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance features 16 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include any local storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage.

The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 23 Gbps, which supports network-heavy operations and communication with external storage volumes. A key hardware tradeoff of this configuration is the complete absence of local storage and integrated GPU hardware, which limits its utility for workloads requiring local scratch space or hardware acceleration. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as a compute-heavy resource where memory capacity is secondary to processing power.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without the resource contention typical of shared-core instances. This makes the hardware profile suitable for compute-bound workloads such as web serving, batch processing, and CI/CD pipelines that do not require massive memory footprints or local disk I/O.
